Namespace ExcelCommon
    Public NotInheritable Class UdfClassLabelPreparation38
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function GuessPositiveClass(explicitText As String, rowCount As Func(Of Integer),
                                                   text As Func(Of Integer, String), binary As Func(Of Integer, Boolean),
                                                   ByRef positiveLabel As String) As Boolean
            positiveLabel = Nothing
            If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(explicitText) Then
                positiveLabel = explicitText
                Return True
            End If
            Dim distinctTokens As New List(Of String)()
            Dim distinctNormalized As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            Dim allBinary01 As Boolean = True
            For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount() - 1
                Dim token As String = text(i)
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(token) Then Continue For
                If Not binary(i) Then allBinary01 = False
                Dim normalized As String = UdfDataImportOptions38.NormalizeOptionKey(token)
                If Not distinctNormalized.Contains(normalized) Then
                    distinctNormalized.Add(normalized)
                    distinctTokens.Add(token)
                End If
            Next
            If allBinary01 Then
                positiveLabel = "1"
                Return True
            End If
            If distinctTokens.Count = 2 Then
                Dim norms As String() = distinctTokens.Select(Function(token) UdfDataImportOptions38.NormalizeOptionKey(token)).ToArray()
                For i As Integer = 0 To norms.Length - 1
                    Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(norms(i), {"positive", "pos", "case", "cases", "event", "events", "yes", "true"})
                        Case "positive", "pos", "case", "cases", "event", "events", "yes", "true"
                            positiveLabel = distinctTokens(i)
                            Return True
                    End Select
                Next
                positiveLabel = distinctTokens(0)
                Return True
            End If
            Return False
        End Function

        ' The native wrapper has already reset its output before converting the
        ' explicit-positive cell. False/throw must retain conversion/callback aliases.
        ' Existing callers keep the original resetting GuessPositiveClass contract.
        Public Shared Function GuessPositiveClassAfterConversion(explicitText As String, rowCount As Func(Of Integer),
                                                                  text As Func(Of Integer, String), binary As Func(Of Integer, Boolean),
                                                                  ByRef positiveLabel As String) As Boolean
            Dim prepared As String = Nothing
            Dim result As Boolean = GuessPositiveClass(explicitText, rowCount, text, binary, prepared)
            If result Then positiveLabel = prepared
            Return result
        End Function
    End Class
End Namespace

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Initialize caller outputs before acquiring host text. Parsing uses
        ''' local outputs so an invalid/throwing conversion retains any changes
        ''' the caller's reader made to its original ByRef storage.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Function TryParseLeveneCenterFromReader(readText As Func(Of String), ByRef useMedian As Boolean, ByRef title As String) As Boolean
            useMedian = False
            title = "Levene Test"

            Dim text As String = readText()
            Dim parsedMedian As Boolean = False
            Dim parsedTitle As String = Nothing
            If Not TryParseLeveneCenter(text, parsedMedian, parsedTitle) Then Return False
            useMedian = parsedMedian
            title = parsedTitle
            Return True
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryParseLeveneCenter(arg As String, ByRef useMedian As Boolean, ByRef title As String) As Boolean
            useMedian = False
            title = "Levene Test"

            Dim s As String = NormalizeText(arg)
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "MEAN") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "LEVENE") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "CLASSICAL") Then
                useMedian = False
                title = "Levene Test"
                Return True
            End If

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(s, New String() {"MEDIAN", "BROWN-FORSYTHE", "BROWNFORSYTHE", "BF"})
                Case "MEDIAN", "BROWN-FORSYTHE", "BROWNFORSYTHE", "BF"
                    useMedian = True
                    title = "Brown-Forsythe Test"
                    Return True
                Case Else
                    Return False
            End Select
        End Function

        Public Shared Function TryParseSymmetryMethod(arg As String, ByRef methodInternal As String, ByRef title As String) As Boolean
            Dim s As String = NormalizeText(arg)
            If LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "MGG") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "MIAO-GEL-GASTWIRTH") OrElse LegacyUdfText38.EqualText(s, "MIAO") Then
                methodInternal = "Miao-Gel-Gastwirth"
                title = "Miao-Gel-Gastwirth Symmetry Test"
                Return True
            End If

            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(s, New String() {"CM", "CABILIO-MASARO", "CABILIO", "MASARO"})
                Case "CM", "CABILIO-MASARO", "CABILIO", "MASARO"
                    methodInternal = "Cabilio-Masaro"
                    title = "Cabilio-Masaro Symmetry Test"
                    Return True
                Case Else
                    Return False
            End Select
        End Function
    End Class

        Public Shared Function CompleteRocInputPrepared(markerCol As Object(,), statusCol As Object(,), positiveLabel As String, isLowerDirection As Boolean, finiteDouble As UdfPlotFiniteDoubleReader38, status01 As UdfPlotStatusReader38, toText As Func(Of Object, String), normalize As Func(Of String, String), ByRef rocInput()() As Double) As Boolean
            Dim pos As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim neg As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim normalizedPositive As String = normalize(positiveLabel)

            For i As Integer = 0 To markerCol.GetLength(0) - 1
                Dim x As Double
                If Not finiteDouble(markerCol(i, 0), x) Then Continue For

                Dim label As String = toText(statusCol(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) Then Continue For

                Dim isPositive As Boolean = False
                Dim iv As Integer
                If normalizedPositive = "1" AndAlso status01(statusCol(i, 0), iv) Then
                    isPositive = (iv = 1)
                Else
                    isPositive = String.Equals(normalize(label), normalizedPositive, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                End If

                If isLowerDirection Then x = -x
                If isPositive Then
                    pos.Add(x)
                Else
                    neg.Add(x)
                End If
            Next

            If pos.Count < 1 OrElse neg.Count < 1 Then Return False
            rocInput = New Double()() {pos.ToArray(), neg.ToArray()}
            Return True
        End Function

            Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
            Dim gList As New List(Of String)()
            Dim stratList As New List(Of String)()

            For i As Integer = 0 To timeCol.GetLength(0) - 1
                Dim t As Double
                Dim s As Integer
                If Not finiteDouble(timeCol(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
                If t < 0.0R Then Return False
                If Not status01(statusCol(i, 0), s) Then Continue For

                Dim g As String = "ALL"
                If hasGroup Then
                    g = toText(groupCol(i, 0))
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For
                End If

                tList.Add(t)
                sList.Add(s)
                gList.Add(g)
                stratList.Add("ALL")
            Next

            If tList.Count < 1 Then Return False

            Dim err As String = Nothing
            records = survival.Survival.CreatSurvivalData(tList.ToArray(), sList.ToArray(), gList.ToArray(), stratList.ToArray(), err)
            Return records IsNot Nothing AndAlso records.Count > 0
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildCalibrationPointsTable(rows As IList(Of Global.BESHStatNG.regression.CalibrationBinSummary), missingIntervalValue As Double) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim out(rows.Count, 7) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Bin"

            out(0, 3) = "ObservedRate"
            out(0, 4) = "LowerCI"
            out(0, 5) = "UpperCI"
            out(0, 6) = "ErrorMinus"
            out(0, 7) = "ErrorPlus"

                out(i + 1, 7) = If(Double.IsNaN(r.UpperCI), missingIntervalValue, r.UpperCI - r.ObservedRate)
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildRocPointsTable(cutoffTable As Object(,), isLowerDirection As Boolean, tryFinite As UdfModelProfilePreparation38.FiniteDoubleReader) As Object(,)
            If cutoffTable Is Nothing OrElse cutoffTable.GetLength(0) < 2 Then
                Return UdfOutputTablesReports38.BuildSimpleNoteTable("ROC", "No ROC cut-off table was returned.").ToOutputModel().Values
            End If

            Dim n As Integer = cutoffTable.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim out(n + 2, 4) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Threshold"
            out(0, 1) = "Sensitivity"
            out(0, 2) = "Specificity"
            out(0, 3) = "FalsePositiveRate"
            out(0, 4) = "TruePositiveRate"

            out(1, 0) = ""
            out(1, 1) = 1.0R
            out(1, 2) = 0.0R
            out(1, 3) = 1.0R
            out(1, 4) = 1.0R

            For i As Integer = 1 To n
                Dim thresholdObj As Object = cutoffTable(i, 0)
                Dim threshold As Double
                If tryFinite(thresholdObj, threshold) Then
                    out(i + 1, 0) = If(isLowerDirection, -threshold, threshold)
                Else
                    out(i + 1, 0) = thresholdObj
                End If

                Dim sens As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 1), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Dim spec As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 2), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                out(i + 1, 1) = sens
                out(i + 1, 2) = spec
                out(i + 1, 3) = 1.0R - spec
                out(i + 1, 4) = sens
            Next

            out(n + 2, 0) = ""
            out(n + 2, 1) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 2) = 1.0R
            out(n + 2, 3) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 4) = 0.0R
            Return out
        End Function

        End Function
        Public Shared Function BuildHistogramPartsPrepared(groups()() As Double, names() As String, resolvedRule As String, computeBins As Func(Of Double(), String, Object(,))) As List(Of Object(,))
            Dim parts As New List(Of Object(,))()

            For i As Integer = 0 To groups.Length - 1

                If values Is Nothing OrElse values.Length < 1 Then Continue For

                Dim bins As Object(,) = computeBins(values, resolvedRule)

                    part(r + 1, 2) = bins(r, 1)
                Next
                parts.Add(part)
            Next

            Return parts
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildHistogramNormalPartsPrepared(groups()() As Double, names() As String, resolvedRule As String, computeBins As Func(Of Double(), String, Object(,)), computeOverlay As Func(Of Double(), Double(), Double(,))) As List(Of Object(,))
            Dim parts As New List(Of Object(,))()

                For r As Integer = 0 To bins.GetLength(0) - 1

                Next

                part(0, 0) = "Group"
                part(0, 1) = "X"
                part(0, 2) = "NormalFrequency"
                For r As Integer = 0 To overlay.GetLength(0) - 1
                    part(r + 1, 0) = names(i)
                    part(r + 1, 1) = overlay(r, 0)
                    part(r + 1, 2) = overlay(r, 1)
                Next
                parts.Add(part)
            Next

            Return parts
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildKaplanMeierStepTablePrepared(rawCurves As Object(), countRecord As Func(Of Object, survival.SurvivalTableRecord), fillRecord As Func(Of Object, survival.SurvivalTableRecord), noteTable As Func(Of String, String, Object(,))) As Object(,)
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1 'header

            For Each groupObj As Object In rawCurves
                If groupObj Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(countRecord).ToList()
                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For
                totalRows += 1 + 2 * recs.Count
            Next

            If totalRows <= 1 Then
                Return noteTable("Kaplan-Meier", "No survival-curve rows were returned.")
            End If

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, 6) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Group"
            out(0, 1) = "PlotOrder"
            out(0, 2) = "Time"
            out(0, 3) = "Survival"
            out(0, 4) = "LowerCI"
            out(0, 5) = "UpperCI"
            out(0, 6) = "AtRisk"

            Dim row As Integer = 1
            For Each groupObj As Object In rawCurves
                If groupObj Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(fillRecord).ToList()
                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For

                Dim groupName As String = recs(0).strGroup
                Dim prevProb As Double = 1.0R
                Dim prevLL As Double = 1.0R
                Dim prevUL As Double = 1.0R
                Dim plotOrder As Integer = 1

                out(row, 0) = groupName
                out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                out(row, 2) = 0.0R
                out(row, 3) = 1.0R
                out(row, 4) = 1.0R
                out(row, 5) = 1.0R
                out(row, 6) = recs(0).AtRisk
                row += 1
                plotOrder += 1

                For Each rec As survival.SurvivalTableRecord In recs
                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = prevProb
                    out(row, 4) = prevLL
                    out(row, 5) = prevUL
                    out(row, 6) = ""
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = rec.Prob
                    out(row, 4) = rec.ProbCILL
                    out(row, 5) = rec.ProbCIUL
                    out(row, 6) = rec.AtRisk
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    prevProb = rec.Prob
                    prevLL = rec.ProbCILL
                    prevUL = rec.ProbCIUL
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

        Public Shared Function StackHomogeneousTablesPrepared(tables As List(Of Object(,))) As Object(,)
            Dim cols As Integer = tables(0).GetLength(1)
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                totalRows += Math.Max(0, tbl.GetLength(0) - 1)
            Next

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, cols - 1) As Object
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                out(0, j) = tables(0)(0, j)
            Next

            Dim row As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                For i As Integer = 1 To tbl.GetLength(0) - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        out(row, j) = tbl(i, j)
                    Next
                    row += 1
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildRosnerTable(alpha As Double, outliers() As Double, addCaution As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim nOut As Integer = If(outliers Is Nothing, 0, outliers.Length)
            Dim rows As Integer = 3 + Math.Max(1, nOut)
            Dim body(rows - 1, 1) As Object
            body(0, 0) = "Alpha"
            body(0, 1) = alpha
            body(1, 0) = "Number of outliers"
            body(1, 1) = nOut
            body(2, 0) = "List of outliers"
            If nOut > 0 Then
                body(2, 1) = outliers(0)
            Else
                body(2, 1) = ""
            End If
            For i As Integer = 1 To nOut - 1
                body(2 + i, 0) = ""
                body(2 + i, 1) = outliers(i)
            Next
            If nOut = 0 Then
                body(3, 0) = ""
                body(3, 1) = ""
            End If

            Dim t As New ResultTable
            t.SetBody(body)
            t.AddHeaderTopRow({"Rosner Generalized ESD Test", ""})
            If addCaution Then
                t.AddFootnote("Interpret with caution for sample sizes below 25.")
            End If
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(t.ToOutputModel(), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function ResolveAvailableAxisCount(preferredAxisCount As Integer, valueSelector As Func(Of Integer, Double())) As Integer
            If preferredAxisCount < 1 OrElse valueSelector Is Nothing Then Return 0
            Dim available As Integer = 0
            For axisIdx As Integer = 0 To preferredAxisCount - 1
                Try
                    Dim values() As Double = valueSelector(axisIdx)
                    If values Is Nothing Then Exit For
                    available += 1
                Catch ex As Exception
                    Exit For
                End Try
            Next
            Return available
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FindWrappedDiscriminantTablePrepared(tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable), title As String, startsWith As Boolean, toText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Object(,)
            For Each t As ResultTable In tables
                Dim arr As Object(,) = t.returnSelf()
                If arr Is Nothing OrElse arr.GetLength(0) < 1 OrElse arr.GetLength(1) < 1 Then Continue For
                Dim candidate As String = toText(arr(0, 0))
                If startsWith Then
                    If candidate.StartsWith(title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                Else
                    If String.Equals(candidate, title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                End If
            Next
            Return Nothing
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FindDiscriminantGroupPrepared(statistics As IEnumerable(Of Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics), requested As String) As Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics
            Dim gs As Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics = Nothing
            For Each item As Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics In statistics
                If String.Equals(item.GroupLabel, requested, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                    gs = item
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next
            Return gs
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildLabeledMatrixOutput(matrix(,) As Double,
                                                  rowNames() As String,
                                                  colNames() As String,
                                                  includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38

            If matrix Is Nothing Then Return UdfReportProjection38.FromFault(UdfReportFault38.NotAvailable)

            Dim nRows As Integer = matrix.GetLength(0)
            Dim nCols As Integer = matrix.GetLength(1)

            If rowNames Is Nothing OrElse rowNames.Length <> nRows Then
                ReDim rowNames(nRows - 1)
                For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                    rowNames(i) = "Row" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Next
            End If

            If colNames Is Nothing OrElse colNames.Length <> nCols Then
                ReDim colNames(nCols - 1)
                For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                    colNames(j) = "Col" & (j + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Next
            End If

            If Not includeHeader Then
                Dim outNoHdr(nRows - 1, nCols - 1) As Object
                For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                        outNoHdr(i, j) = UdfReportProjection38.SafeNumber(matrix(i, j))
                    Next
                Next
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(outNoHdr), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim out(nRows, nCols) As Object
            out(0, 0) = ""

            For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                out(0, j + 1) = colNames(j)
            Next

            For i As Integer = 0 To nRows - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = rowNames(i)
                For j As Integer = 0 To nCols - 1
                    out(i + 1, j + 1) = UdfReportProjection38.SafeNumber(matrix(i, j))
                Next

        Public Shared Function BuildOneWayMcpTables(data()() As Double, names() As String, which As String, alphaValue As Double, ByRef stackAll As Boolean) As List(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable)
            Dim mdl As New Global.BESHStatNG.parametric.OneWayANOVA(data, names)

            stackAll = False
            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(which, New String() {"", "TUKEY", "TUKEYKRAMER", "TUKEY-KRAMER", "TK", "GAMESHOWELL", "GAMES-HOWELL", "GH", "GAMES", "LSD", "FISHER", "FISHERLSD", "FISHER-LSD", "BONF", "BONFERRONI", "ALL", "BOTH"})
                Case "", "TUKEY", "TUKEYKRAMER", "TUKEY-KRAMER", "TK"
                    mdl.TukeyKramer(alphaValue)
                Case "GAMESHOWELL", "GAMES-HOWELL", "GH", "GAMES"
                    mdl.GamesHowell(alphaValue)
                Case "LSD", "FISHER", "FISHERLSD", "FISHER-LSD"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(False, alphaValue)
                Case "BONF", "BONFERRONI"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(True, alphaValue)

                    mdl.FisherLSD(False, alphaValue)
                    mdl.FisherLSD(True, alphaValue)
                    mdl.TukeyKramer(alphaValue)
                    mdl.GamesHowell(alphaValue)
                    stackAll = True
                Case Else

            If cutoffTable Is Nothing OrElse cutoffTable.GetLength(0) < 2 Then
                Return UdfOutputTablesReports38.BuildSimpleNoteTable("ROC", "No ROC cut-off table was returned.").ToOutputModel().Values
            End If

            Dim n As Integer = cutoffTable.GetLength(0) - 1

            For i As Integer = 1 To n
                Dim thresholdObj As Object = cutoffTable(i, 0)

            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1 'header

                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For

                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For
                totalRows += 1 + 2 * recs.Count

                row += 1

                For Each rec As survival.SurvivalTableRecord In recs

                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time

                    out(row, 4) = prevLL
                    out(row, 5) = prevUL
                    out(row, 6) = ""
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = rec.Prob
                    out(row, 4) = rec.ProbCILL
                    out(row, 5) = rec.ProbCIUL
                    out(row, 6) = rec.AtRisk

                Next

        Public Shared Function StackHomogeneousTablesPrepared(tables As List(Of Object(,))) As Object(,)
            Dim cols As Integer = tables(0).GetLength(1)
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                totalRows += Math.Max(0, tbl.GetLength(0) - 1)
            Next

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, cols - 1) As Object
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                out(0, j) = tables(0)(0, j)
            Next

            Dim row As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                For i As Integer = 1 To tbl.GetLength(0) - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        out(row, j) = tbl(i, j)
                    Next
                    row += 1
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(countRecord).ToList()
                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For
                totalRows += 1 + 2 * recs.Count
            Next

            If totalRows <= 1 Then

            out(0, 5) = "UpperCI"
            out(0, 6) = "AtRisk"

            For Each groupObj As Object In rawCurves

                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(fillRecord).ToList()
                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For

                Dim prevUL As Double = 1.0R

                out(row, 0) = groupName
                out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                out(row, 2) = 0.0R
                out(row, 3) = 1.0R
                out(row, 4) = 1.0R
                out(row, 5) = 1.0R
                out(row, 6) = recs(0).AtRisk
                row += 1
                plotOrder += 1

                For Each rec As survival.SurvivalTableRecord In recs
                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = prevProb
                    out(row, 4) = prevLL
                    out(row, 5) = prevUL
                    out(row, 6) = ""
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = rec.Prob
                    out(row, 4) = rec.ProbCILL
                    out(row, 5) = rec.ProbCIUL
                    out(row, 6) = rec.AtRisk
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    prevProb = rec.Prob
                    prevLL = rec.ProbCILL
                    prevUL = rec.ProbCIUL
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function StackHomogeneousTablesPrepared(tables As List(Of Object(,))) As Object(,)
            Dim cols As Integer = tables(0).GetLength(1)
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                totalRows += Math.Max(0, tbl.GetLength(0) - 1)
            Next

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, cols - 1) As Object
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                out(0, j) = tables(0)(0, j)
            Next

            Dim row As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                For i As Integer = 1 To tbl.GetLength(0) - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        out(row, j) = tbl(i, j)
                    Next
                    row += 1
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildGrubbsTable(alpha As Double, res As TestResult) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim t As New ResultTable
            t.SetBody(New Object(,) {
                {"Alpha", alpha},
                {"Critical statistic", res.TestStatistics1},
                {"Observed statistic", res.TestStatistics2},
                {"Result", If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(res.strSpecialInformation), "", res.strSpecialInformation)}
            })
            t.AddHeaderTopRow({"Grubbs Test", ""})
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(t.ToOutputModel(), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildRosnerTable(alpha As Double, outliers() As Double, addCaution As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim nOut As Integer = If(outliers Is Nothing, 0, outliers.Length)
            Dim rows As Integer = 3 + Math.Max(1, nOut)
            Dim body(rows - 1, 1) As Object
            body(0, 0) = "Alpha"
            body(0, 1) = alpha
            body(1, 0) = "Number of outliers"
            body(1, 1) = nOut
            body(2, 0) = "List of outliers"
            If nOut > 0 Then
                body(2, 1) = outliers(0)
            Else
                body(2, 1) = ""
            End If
            For i As Integer = 1 To nOut - 1
                body(2 + i, 0) = ""
                body(2 + i, 1) = outliers(i)
            Next
            If nOut = 0 Then
                body(3, 0) = ""
                body(3, 1) = ""
            End If

            Dim t As New ResultTable
            t.SetBody(body)
            t.AddHeaderTopRow({"Rosner Generalized ESD Test", ""})
            If addCaution Then
                t.AddFootnote("Interpret with caution for sample sizes below 25.")
            End If
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(t.ToOutputModel(), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function
    End Class

Public NotInheritable Class MultivariateAnalysisUDFsReports38
        Private Sub New()
        End Sub

        Public Shared Function BuildClusterPreprocessingTable(varNames() As String, locations() As Double, scales() As Double,
                                                        mode As Multivariate.ClusterStandardizationMode) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim varCount As Integer = 0
            If varNames IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = varNames.Length
            ElseIf locations IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = locations.Length
            ElseIf scales IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = scales.Length
            End If

            If mode = Multivariate.ClusterStandardizationMode.None OrElse varCount <= 0 Then
                Dim note(1, 1) As Object
                note(0, 0) = "Setting"
                note(0, 1) = "Value"
                note(1, 0) = "Standardization"
                note(1, 1) = "None"
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(note), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim out(varCount, 2) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Variable"
            out(0, 1) = "Location"
            out(0, 2) = "Scale"
            For i As Integer = 0 To varCount - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = If(varNames IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < varNames.Length, CType(varNames(i), Object), CType("X" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Object))
                out(i + 1, 1) = If(locations IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < locations.Length, CType(locations(i), Object), CType(Nothing, Object))
                out(i + 1, 2) = If(scales IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < scales.Length, CType(scales(i), Object), CType(Nothing, Object))
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildRemovedRowsOutput(rowIds() As Integer, rowLabels() As String) As UdfReportProjection38
            If rowIds Is Nothing OrElse rowIds.Length = 0 Then
                Dim note(1, 1) As Object
                note(0, 0) = "Setting"
                note(0, 1) = "Value"
                note(1, 0) = "Removed rows"
                note(1, 1) = "None"
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(note), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim hasLabels As Boolean = (rowLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowLabels.Length = rowIds.Length)
            Dim out(rowIds.Length, If(hasLabels, 2, 1)) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "OriginalRow"
            If hasLabels Then
                out(0, 1) = "RowLabel"
                out(0, 2) = "Reason"
            Else
                out(0, 1) = "Reason"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rowIds.Length - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = rowIds(i)
                If hasLabels Then
                    out(i + 1, 1) = rowLabels(i)
                    out(i + 1, 2) = "Removed before fitting because at least one analysis variable was missing or non-finite."
                Else
                    out(i + 1, 1) = "Removed before fitting because at least one analysis variable was missing or non-finite."
                End If
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildHierarchicalLeafOrderTable(result As Multivariate.HierarchicalClusterResult) As UdfReportProjection38
            If result Is Nothing Then Return Nothing

            Dim n As Integer = If(result.ActiveRowIndices Is Nothing, 0, result.ActiveRowIndices.Length)
            Dim out(Math.Max(n, 1), 2) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "DisplayOrder"
            out(0, 1) = "OriginalRow"
            out(0, 2) = "RowLabel"
            If n = 0 Then
                out(1, 0) = 1
                out(1, 1) = Nothing
                out(1, 2) = Nothing
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim labelByRow As New Dictionary(Of Integer, String)
            If result.ActiveRowLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.ActiveRowLabels.Length = n Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                    labelByRow(result.ActiveRowIndices(i)) = result.ActiveRowLabels(i)
                Next
            End If

            Dim displayOrder() As Integer = If(result.LeafOrder IsNot Nothing AndAlso result.LeafOrder.Length = n,
                                               result.LeafOrder,
                                               result.ActiveRowIndices)
            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                Dim rowId As Integer = displayOrder(i)
                out(i + 1, 0) = i + 1
                out(i + 1, 1) = rowId
                out(i + 1, 2) = If(labelByRow.ContainsKey(rowId), CType(labelByRow(rowId), Object), CType("Obs " & rowId.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Object))
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildCaEigenOutput(model As Multivariate.CA, includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            If model Is Nothing OrElse model.Eigenvalues Is Nothing Then Return UdfReportProjection38.FromFault(UdfReportFault38.NotAvailable)
            Dim eigen() As Double = model.Eigenvalues
            Dim pct(,) As Double = model.Percents
            Dim out(eigen.Length - 1 + If(includeHeader, 1, 0), 3) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0
            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = "Axis"
                out(0, 1) = "Inertia"
                out(0, 2) = "% Inertia"
                out(0, 3) = "Cumulative % Inertia"
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To eigen.Length - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = "Dim " & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                out(r0 + i, 1) = eigen(i)
                out(r0 + i, 2) = pct(i, 0)
                out(r0 + i, 3) = pct(i, 1)
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildCaOverviewOutput(idHeader As String,
                                               names() As String,

        Public Shared Function ResolveAvailableAxisCount(preferredAxisCount As Integer, valueSelector As Func(Of Integer, Double())) As Integer
            If preferredAxisCount < 1 OrElse valueSelector Is Nothing Then Return 0
            Dim available As Integer = 0
            For axisIdx As Integer = 0 To preferredAxisCount - 1
                Try
                    Dim values() As Double = valueSelector(axisIdx)
                    If values Is Nothing Then Exit For
                    available += 1
                Catch ex As Exception
                    Exit For
                End Try
            Next
            Return available
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildDiscriminantMeansTable(model As Multivariate.DiscriminantAnalysis,
                                                     useOriginalScale As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            If model Is Nothing OrElse model.GroupStatistics Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Dim g As Integer = model.GroupStatistics.Count
            If g < 1 Then Return Nothing
            Dim p As Integer = model.GroupStatistics(0).MeanOriginal.Length
            Dim out(g, p) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Group"
            For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                out(0, j + 1) = model.PreparedData.VariableNames(j)
            Next
            For i As Integer = 0 To g - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = model.GroupStatistics(i).GroupLabel
                Dim values() As Double = If(useOriginalScale, model.GroupStatistics(i).MeanOriginal, model.GroupStatistics(i).MeanWorking)
                For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                    out(i + 1, j + 1) = values(j)
                Next
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function
        Public Shared Function FindWrappedDiscriminantTablePrepared(tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable), title As String, startsWith As Boolean, toText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Object(,)
            For Each t As ResultTable In tables
                Dim arr As Object(,) = t.returnSelf()
                If arr Is Nothing OrElse arr.GetLength(0) < 1 OrElse arr.GetLength(1) < 1 Then Continue For
                Dim candidate As String = toText(arr(0, 0))
                If startsWith Then
                    If candidate.StartsWith(title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                Else
                    If String.Equals(candidate, title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                End If
            Next
            Return Nothing
        End Function

        Public Shared Function FindDiscriminantGroupPrepared(statistics As IEnumerable(Of Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics), requested As String) As Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics
            Dim gs As Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics = Nothing
            For Each item As Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics In statistics
                If String.Equals(item.GroupLabel, requested, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
                    gs = item
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next
            Return gs
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildOneWayAnovaTable(data()() As Double, names() As String) As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable
            Dim mdl As New Global.BESHStatNG.parametric.OneWayANOVA(data, names)
            mdl.compute()
            Dim tables = mdl.wrapResults()
            Return tables(0)
        End Function

        Public Shared Function BuildWelchAnovaTable(data()() As Double, names() As String) As Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable
            Dim mdl As New Global.BESHStatNG.parametric.OneWayANOVA(data, names)
            mdl.compute()
            Dim w = mdl.WelshANOVA()

            Dim body(0, 3) As Object
            body(0, 0) = data.Length - 1
            body(0, 1) = w.DF1
            body(0, 2) = w.TestStatistics1
            body(0, 3) = w.Pvalue

            Dim t As New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable
            t.SetBody(body)
            t.AddPvalueToFormat(4)
            t.AddHeaderLeftRow({"Welch ANOVA"})
            t.AddHeaderTopRow({"Source", "df numerator", "df denominator", "F", "P-value"})
            Return t
        End Function

        ' Invalid selectors are resolved only AFTER construction/compute, as originally.
        ' wrapResults always supplies a non-null List in the pinned Core engine.
        Public Shared Function BuildOneWayMcpTables(data()() As Double, names() As String, which As String, alphaValue As Double, ByRef stackAll As Boolean) As List(Of Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTable)
            Dim mdl As New Global.BESHStatNG.parametric.OneWayANOVA(data, names)
            mdl.compute()
            stackAll = False
            Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(which, New String() {"", "TUKEY", "TUKEYKRAMER", "TUKEY-KRAMER", "TK", "GAMESHOWELL", "GAMES-HOWELL", "GH", "GAMES", "LSD", "FISHER", "FISHERLSD", "FISHER-LSD", "BONF", "BONFERRONI", "ALL", "BOTH"})
                Case "", "TUKEY", "TUKEYKRAMER", "TUKEY-KRAMER", "TK"
                    mdl.TukeyKramer(alphaValue)
                Case "GAMESHOWELL", "GAMES-HOWELL", "GH", "GAMES"
                    mdl.GamesHowell(alphaValue)
                Case "LSD", "FISHER", "FISHERLSD", "FISHER-LSD"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(False, alphaValue)
                Case "BONF", "BONFERRONI"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(True, alphaValue)
                Case "ALL", "BOTH"
                    mdl.FisherLSD(False, alphaValue)
                    mdl.FisherLSD(True, alphaValue)
                    mdl.TukeyKramer(alphaValue)
                    mdl.GamesHowell(alphaValue)
                    stackAll = True
                Case Else
                    Return Nothing
            End Select
            Return mdl.wrapResults()
        End Function
    End Class
